manifests._comment: Sub-extensions are versioned independently: the library lives in its own submodule/repo and bumps on its own cadence (lib v1.1.3 != package v1.1.4); the plugins only bump when their code actually changes. cwm-bump from this repo therefore only touches the package wrapper manifest below. To bump the library, run the bump from its own repo; to bump a plugin, edit its manifest directly.

_schemaReplay_comment: Deliberately absent. This repository ships no SQL at all — no .sql files, and none of scripturelinks.xml, the two plugin manifests or the package manifest declares <sql> or <schemapath>. The only <schemapath> anywhere in the tree belongs to libraries/lib_cwmscripture, a git submodule whose migrations are committed in that repository and gated by cwm-schema-replay there. Replaying them from here would run another project's code and duplicate its gate — the same ownership line vendor:check draws. Add a schemaReplay block if this repository ever ships a <schemapath> of its own.

includes._comment: subBuild, not prebuilt: prebuilt only globs build/dist and breaks ties by mtime, so the package bundled whatever library zip was last written rather than the pinned submodule commit — 1.2.2 shipped lib 1.1.10 that way (issue #23). subBuild runs the library's own build first, so the just-produced zip is newest by construction and the bundle always derives from the pin. distGlob is relative to `path` here, unlike prebuilt.

ars.itemDescription: CWM Scripture Links package — bundles the shared scripture library, the content plugin that processes {scripture}/{bible} tags in Joomla articles, and the task plugin for background translation downloads.

_versionTracking_comment: Override on top of the 'package-wrapper' profile. Lists replace wholesale, so paths fully redefines the scan roots (profile default is just src/ + language/) — every root this repo ships must be named here or its @since tags ship as the literal token. Paths resolve from the repo root, so a sub-extension's own src/ is NOT covered by the bare 'src/' entry; that is how plg_system_cwmscripture shipped five placeholders through 1.2.5 (#27). libraries/ is deliberately absent: it is the lib_cwmscripture submodule, which substitutes its own tree during its own release — listing it here stamped library files with this package's version, a version that repo has never had. build/ and .php-cs-fixer.dist.php stay out as tooling, not shipped code.
